title: 第16章 弒神绝骨三箭镇天骨第17章 祖凤涅槃诀
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: “谁让你走的。”
冰冷的声音突然间响起，城主齐殤的话刚刚落下，两位实丹境武者瞬间拦截住苏辰。
四周围观的武者，似乎都没有惊讶，因为此人当眾斩杀董家六位虚丹境，这里又是天骨城，城主怎么可能任由此人离开。
实丹境武者，完全不是虚丹境武者能够比擬的。
不仅仅是城主府，哪怕是夏家也出动两位实丹境武者。
整整四位实丹境，將苏辰围在正中央。
董希冷笑著说道：“小子，我董希说话一定算话，你和我董家之间的恩怨到此为止，至於你在天骨城如此放肆，那便是城主府的事情。”
不要脸！
够无耻！
苏辰却是笑了。
“你笑什么？”
“我笑你无耻都不脸红，天骨城想要留下我，也要看看你们是否有那个本事。”
此话够狂！
也够霸道！
夏泉满脸笑意地说道：“阁下能够击败虚丹境，的確有过人之处，不过这里是天骨城，你在这里当眾杀人，应该要给城主府一个交代。”
白狐的身影突然出现在苏辰面前，冰冷的双眼盯著面前眾人。
“白狐，回来。”
直接选择无视夏梨顏，吱吱地叫著。
摸了摸白狐的脑袋，苏辰笑著说道：“谢谢你的好意，你先离开这里。”
白狐低头想了想，最终还是听了苏辰的话，身影快速地消失在眾人视线之中。
看著四周的四位实丹境，並且苏辰能够断言，天骨城城主，包括其他两位家主应该都是金丹境，自己能够斩杀虚丹境，未必可以抗衡实丹境，更何况是金丹境。
选择放弃，肯定是不可能的。
“全部滚开，挡我者死！”
必须离开天骨城。
听到此话，城主齐殤笑了，任谁都能够看得出来，齐殤的笑声里蕴含著肆无忌惮的嘲讽和轻蔑。
能够击杀六位虚丹境，不代表可以击败实丹境武者，更加不可能抗衡金丹境城主。
齐殤没有丝毫的怜悯，在他看来，自己身为天骨城城主，要做的事情就是维护自己的尊严，任何人都不得侵犯，更何况是一个筑基境。
四位实丹境武者，直接朝著苏辰轰击而去。
眼神已经森冷到极限，苏辰手里瞬间出现一柄黑色长弓，正是之前在天罚森林得到的弒神绝骨弓，並且一支弒神绝骨箭出现在弓上。
如今的弒神绝骨弓被镇压在混沌体內，还有著八位佛陀相助，因为担心被反噬的原因，不到万不得已的情况下，他绝对不愿意隨意动用此弓。
只是现在，情况已经完全不同。
面对四位实丹境，外加金丹境的城主，要是不动用弒神绝骨弓，很难活著离开天骨城。
开弓，拉箭。
顿时间，一股股至凶至霸的恐怖杀意，从弒神绝骨弓內奔腾嘶吼而出，所有人的脸色都彻底变了，包括四位实丹境武者，激灵灵地打了个冷颤。
content_en:
"Who asked you to leave?"
A cold voice suddenly sounded, and as soon as the city lord Qi Shang finished speaking, two warriors in the real elixir realm instantly intercepted Su Chen.
None of the warriors watching around seemed surprised, because this man killed six Void Core Realm members of the Dong family in public, and this was Tiangu City. How could the city lord let this man leave.
Warriors in the Real Dan Realm are completely incomparable to warriors in the Virtual Dan Realm.
Not only the City Lord's Mansion, but also the Xia family dispatched two real-elin realm warriors.
A total of four people in the real elixir realm surrounded Su Chen in the center.
Dong hope sneered and said: "Boy, I, Dong hope, must keep my word. The grudge between you and my Dong family ends here. As for you being so wanton in Tiangu City, that is a matter for the City Lord's Mansion."
Shameless!
Shameless enough!
Su Chen smiled.
"What are you laughing at?"
"I don't even blush when I laugh at your shamelessness. If Tiangu City wants to keep me, it also wants to see if you have the ability."
This is crazy!
Too domineering!
Xia Quan said with a smile on his face: "Your Excellency is indeed capable of defeating the Void Core Realm. However, this is Tiangu City. If you kill people in public here, you should give an explanation to the City Lord's Mansion."
The figure of the white fox suddenly appeared in front of Su Chen, staring at the people in front of him with cold eyes.
"White Fox, come back."
She simply chose to ignore Xia Liyan and screamed.
After touching the white fox's head, Su Chen said with a smile: "Thank you for your kindness. Please leave here first."
Bai Hu lowered his head and thought for a while, and finally listened to Su Chen's words, and his figure quickly disappeared from everyone's sight.
Looking at the four real elixir realms around him, Su Chen could conclude that the Lord of Tiangu City, including the other two family heads, should all be in the golden elixir realm. If he could kill the virtual elixir realm, he might not be able to compete with the real elixir realm, let alone the golden elixir realm.
It is definitely impossible to choose to give up.
"Everyone get out of here, anyone who stands in my way will die!"
We must leave Tiangu City.
Upon hearing this, the city lord Qi Shang smiled, and anyone could see that Qi Shang's laughter contained unbridled ridicule and contempt.
Being able to kill six Void Core Realm warriors does not mean that one can defeat the Real Core Realm warriors, let alone the Golden Core Realm City Lord.
"Kill!"
Qi Shang showed no mercy at all. In his opinion, as the lord of Tiangu City, what he had to do was to maintain his own dignity, which no one could infringe upon, let alone a foundation-building realm.
The four real elixir realm warriors bombarded Su Chen directly.
His eyes were extremely cold, and a black long bow instantly appeared in Su Chen's hand. It was the God-killing bone bow that he had obtained in the Heavenly Punishment Forest, and a God-killing bone arrow appeared on the bow.
Nowadays, the God-killing Bone Bow is suppressed in the body of Chaos, and there are eight Buddhas to help him. Because he is worried about being backlashed, he is absolutely unwilling to use this bow unless it is absolutely necessary.
Only now, the situation is completely different.
Facing four real elixir realm, plus a golden elixir realm city lord, it would be difficult to leave Tiangu City alive without using the God-killing Bone Bow.
Draw the bow and draw the arrow.
Immediately, waves of terrifying murderous intent roared out from the God-killing Bone Bow. Everyone's expressions changed completely, including the four Real-Elixir Realm warriors, who shivered violently.
